english.title: Recklessly give a false answer in response to a question to establish if qualified to serve as juror
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) recklessly gave an answer which was false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSIFICATION..), in response to a question from a senior coroner that appeared necessary to establish whether or not you were qualified to serve as a juror at an inquest
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 2(1)(c) and (2) of Schedule 6 to the Coroners and Justice Act 2009.
